evidence: The frozen workbook row 31 (Quality Checks!A32:D32; Internal Quality Checks!A32:D32) and quality-checks.md section 31 require plural promises to be checked across all matches. security.md:5 names five separately prohibited execution families (eval, Function, WebAssembly, new workers, dynamic module imports) and says the same words in strings or comments are harmless. The sole cw_preview_boundary criterion at tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:194 asks for only 'a real prohibited dynamic-execution attempt' and a positive control with harmless 'quoted words'; it does not require each named family or a comment control. The same line says 'parent-document/origin-storage access', which permits one of those two surfaces to be sampled while the other remains open. behaviour.md:7 requires an older cancelled run not to overwrite a newer preview or console, but cw_timeout_stop_and_supersession at functional/judge.toml:185 allows the judge to start a delayed marker and then 'Run a distinct newer marker or press Stop'. Choosing Stop leaves the newer-Run supersession case untested. By contrast, functional/judge.toml:68, :86 and :104 explicitly check all three carets, all three find matches and all four replace-all occurrences; :95 and :212 scope unchanged checks to source or the saved identity. The manifest's input hash matches the assignment, and the cited frozen security.md, behaviour.md, functional/judge.toml, workbook and skill file hashes match its inputs. No raw-evidence-index.json exists in this run, so these are source-proven probe gaps, not observed app failures or a full judge measurement.
counterexample: A plausible broken app can reject eval but allow Function, WebAssembly, workers and import(), and reject quoted keywords while accepting the single positive string fixture. Another can cancel correctly on Stop but let a late callback from an earlier run overwrite a newer Run. Both can satisfy the present single-choice probes. A conforming app can preserve the earlier gate record while saving a new identity; 'one record' in functional/judge.toml:203 must be read as one record for that identity, consistent with tests/app_context.md's instruction not to assume an empty library, so that legitimate record is not a failure.
suggested_fix: Require separate bounded positive and negative probes for every named prohibited execution family, ordinary strings and comments, and both parent and origin-storage access; require the delayed-marker test to exercise newer-Run supersession and Stop separately, each with its own later-observation window. Clarify that 'one record' means one record for the captured identity.
